title: Chelsea have 38 players out on loan – but who and where are they?
trail: A remarkable 38 Chelsea players are out on loan in countries ranging from Turkey to Colombia and taking in clubs from Juventus to Metropolitan Police
body: A remarkable 38 Chelsea players are out on loan after seven left the club on a temporary basis on deadline day. Teams in England, Spain, Germany, the Netherlands, Italy, Belgium, Turkey, Colombia and Brazil have borrowed players from Chelsea. From Juventus (Juan Cuadrado) to non-league Metropolitan Police (Nathan Baxter) there are clubs with a Chelsea player in their ranks. Eighteen of the 38 out on loan are aged 21 or older, with Baxter the youngest at 17 and Loïc Rémy, now 29, the eldest. Almost 15% of Football League clubs have borrowed a player from Stamford Bridge in this window, 10 of the 72 teams having done so, with the final such move being Christian Atsu’s to Newcastle United in the last hour before the transfer deadline on Wednesday. All the players listed below are on a season’s loan unless stated.
